components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only button: solid ink rectangle with paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #fff; font: 500 15px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, scale 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #3d3d3d; } .ds-btn:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Underlined Link
components.description: Secondary actions and inline links; always underlined.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #0a0a0a; font: 500 15px Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hairline Row
components.description: Definition-list row: medium term in a fixed column, soft-ink detail, hairline between rows.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-rows { margin: 0; font: 400 18px/1.556 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-rows > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 15rem 1fr; gap: 32px; padding: 20px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(10 10 10 / 0.12); } .ds-rows > div:first-child { border-top: 0; padding-top: 0; } .ds-rows dt { font-weight: 500; } .ds-rows dd { margin: 0; color: #3d3d3d; }

components.name: Figure Plate
components.description: Anatomy-kit Plate, light theme: mono corners (Fig n, title, hint, readout), one lit part, legend and true caption.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; } .ds-plate-box { position: relative; height: 220px; background: #fbfbfa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #8a8a8f; } .ds-plate-box span { position: absolute; font: 10.5px/1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #8c8c90; } [data-c=fig] { top: 18px; left: 20px; color: #57575a; } [data-c=title] { top: 18px; right: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; color: #57575a; } [data-c=hint] { bottom: 18px; left: 20px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; } [data-c=readout] { bottom: 18px; right: 20px; color: #57575a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate figcaption { margin-top: 12px; max-width: 68ch; font: 14px/1.55 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3d3d3d; }

narrative.overview: The site reads like a printed catalogue of machines. Each workflow is drawn as a real isometric machine on its own plate, and the words beside it are plain. The page is white paper with black ink, divided by hairline rules. Grey appears only in supporting text and in the drawings' tone ramp. The figure carries the visual weight, and the type, buttons and rules stay quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white ground and near-black ink. No accent colour.
Geist for reading text, set large. Geist Mono only for figure measurement.
Hairline rules in place of cards, fills or shadows.
Isometric anatomy plates as the only illustration, rendered as SVG in code.
A faint Paper Shaders grain, used once on the closing band.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Rule
rules.body: v1 is black and white. The kit's red, green and blue tones stay unused.

rules.name: The One Lit Part Rule
rules.body: Inside a figure, pure black is reserved for the one part the visitor should look at.

rules.name: The Weight 500 Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 500, never bold. Hierarchy comes from size and tracking.

rules.name: The Mono Is Measurement Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono and uppercase tracking appear only on plate corners and readouts.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from hairlines and whitespace, never shadows or filled cards.

dos: Do separate content with hairline rules and whitespace.
Do set reading text at 18px or larger in Geist, with measures between 44ch and 60ch.
Do draw every workflow as an anatomy Plate in the light theme, with one lit part and a true caption that says "illustrative example".
Do underline links, and use the single black button for the primary action.
donts: Don't add an accent colour or the kit's red, green or blue tones while v1 is black and white.
Don't add box shadows, filled cards or tinted section backgrounds to the page.
Don't use Geist Mono or uppercase tracked labels outside figure plates.
Don't use Paper Shaders as a colour or motion effect.
Don't ship raster figures. The .impeccable/mocks PNGs are abandoned comps.
